<style type="text/css">
  .newspaper-header {
    background: linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #0f0a2e 0%,
      #1e1b4b 30%,
      #312e81 55%,
      #0891b2 80%,
      #7c3aed 100%
    );

    text-align: center;
    padding: 28px 20px 24px;
    border-top: 6px double #22d3ee;
    border-bottom: 6px double #c084fc;
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15),
      0 4px 24px rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.35);
    position: relative;
  }

  /* Decorative lines */
  .newspaper-header::before,
  .newspaper-header::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: 92%;
    height: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #22d3ee, #a78bfa, #f472b6);
  }

  .newspaper-header::before {
    top: 14px;
  }

  .newspaper-header::after {
    bottom: 14px;
  }

  /* Date line */
  .header-top {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    font-size: 10px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    gap: 8px;
    color: #bae6fd;
  }

  .header-top-end {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  /* Newspaper title */
  .newspaper-title {
    font-family: "Cinzel", serif;
    font-size: 40px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 5px;
    margin: 0;
    line-height: 1;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #22d3ee 0%, #e879f9 50%, #f472b6 100%);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    background-clip: text;
    color: transparent;
    text-shadow: none;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 8px rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.4));
  }

  /* Subtitle */
  .subtitle {
    margin-top: 8px;
    font-size: 14px;
    letter-spacing: 3px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #c4b5fd;
  }

  /* Small ornament */
  .ornament {
    font-size: 20px;
    margin: 10px 0;
    color: #67e8f9;
  }

  /* Tabs container */
  .tabs {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: normal;
    text-align: left;
  }

  .menu {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    flex-wrap: nowrap;
    gap: 0.35rem;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0.75rem 0.6rem 1.5rem;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    overflow-x: auto;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    background: linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      #4c1d95 0%,
      #7c3aed 20%,
      #0891b2 50%,
      #06b6d4 80%,

    border: 2px solid #6366f1;
    border-top: none;
    position: relative;
  }

  .menu::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 22px;
    left: 8%;
    right: 8%;
    height: 1px;
    background: rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.35);
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
  }

  .chronicle-timeline-head {
    display: block;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 8px 8px 6px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #312e81 0%, #7c3aed 50%, #06b6d4 100%);

  .chronicle-timeline-head-sub {

  .tab {

  .tab::after {

    bottom: 14px;
    left: calc(50% + 10px);

    height: 1px;

    z-index: 0;

  .tab:last-child::after {

  .timeline-node {

  .timeline-node--wide {

  .tab-label {

  }

  /* Skjulte radio – forum støtter ofte ikke :has() */
  .chronicle-tab-input {

    padding: 0;

    clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);

  #chronicle-tab-1:checked ~ .menu-wrap label[for="chronicle-tab-1"],
  #chronicle-tab-2:checked ~ .menu-wrap label[for="chronicle-tab-2"],
  #chronicle-tab-3:checked ~ .menu-wrap label[for="chronicle-tab-3"],
  #chronicle-tab-4:checked ~ .menu-wrap label[for="chronicle-tab-4"],

  #chronicle-tab-1:checked

  #chronicle-tab-2:checked

  #chronicle-tab-1:checked ~ .menu-wrap label[for="chronicle-tab-1"] .tab-label,

  <canvas id="matrix-bg"></canvas>
  <script>
    const canvas = document.getElementById("matrix-bg");
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

    // Set canvas size
    function resizeCanvas() {
      canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
      canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    }
    resizeCanvas();
    window.addEventListener("resize", resizeCanvas);

    // NB!!! Matrix characters ‼️YOU CAN CHANGE THEM IF YOU LIKE TO‼️
    const chars =
      "0123456789天地人水火木金土日月星辰风云雨雪山川河流海洋森林城市国家世界宇宙科技数据系统网络信息";
    const charArray = chars.split("");

    // Columns
    const fontSize = 20;
    const columns = Math.floor(canvas.width / fontSize);
    const drops = [];

    // Initialize drops
    for (let i = 0; i < columns; i++) {
      drops[i] = 1;
    }

    // Draw function
    function draw() {
      // Aurora fade
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(15, 10, 46, 0.07)";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      ctx.font = "bold " + fontSize + "px monospace";

      // -------------------------DO NOT REMOVE---------------------//
      // Loop over drops
      for (let i = 0; i < drops.length; i++) {
        // Random character
        const char = charArray[Math.floor(Math.random() * charArray.length)];

        // Cyan-to-violet aurora
        const hue = 190 + (i % 7) * 14;
        const lightness = 52 - (drops[i] % 5) * 4;
        ctx.fillStyle = `hsl(${hue}, 85%, ${Math.max(38, lightness)}%)`;

        // Draw character
        ctx.fillText(char, i * fontSize, drops[i] * fontSize);

        // Reset drop to top with random delay
        if (drops[i] * fontSize > canvas.height && Math.random() > 0.975) {
          drops[i] = 0;
        }

        drops[i]++;
      }
    }

    // Animation loop the lower the number below the faster the matrix will fall! put it to 50 it falls slower. Pretty cool.
    setInterval(draw, 30);

    (function () {
      var VIDEO_ID = "J3zsl9QMyQc";
      var btn = document.getElementById("chronicle-music-btn");
      var playing = true;
      var player;

      if (!btn) return;

      function setLabel(paused) {
        btn.textContent = paused ? "▶ Spill" : "⏸ Pause";
        playing = !paused;
      }

      function toggleMusic() {
        if (!player || typeof player.pauseVideo !== "function") return;
        if (playing) {
          player.pauseVideo();
          setLabel(true);
        } else {
          player.playVideo();
          setLabel(false);
        }
      }

      btn.addEventListener("click", toggleMusic);

      document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
        if (e.key !== "Enter") return;
        var tag =
          e.target && e.target.tagName ? e.target.tagName.toLowerCase() : "";
        if (tag === "input" || tag === "textarea" || tag === "select") return;
        e.preventDefault();
        toggleMusic();
      });

      window.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady = function () {
        player = new YT.Player("chronicle-yt-mount", {
          height: "1",
          width: "1",
          videoId: VIDEO_ID,
          playerVars: {
            autoplay: 1,
            loop: 1,
            playlist: VIDEO_ID,
            controls: 0,
            modestbranding: 1,
            rel: 0,
            playsinline: 1,
            fs: 0,
            disablekb: 1,
          },
          events: {
            onReady: function (ev) {
              ev.target.setVolume(60);
              ev.target.playVideo();
            },
          },
        });
      };

      var api = document.createElement("script");
      api.src = "https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api";
      document.head.appendChild(api);
    })();
  </script>
</p>

<p>
  <canvas id="matrix-bg"></canvas>
  <script>
    const canvas = document.getElementById("matrix-bg");
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

    // Set canvas size
    function resizeCanvas() {
      canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
      canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    }
    resizeCanvas();
    window.addEventListener("resize", resizeCanvas);

    // NB!!! Matrix characters ‼️YOU CAN CHANGE THEM IF YOU LIKE TO‼️
    const chars =
      "0123456789天地人水火木金土日月星辰风云雨雪山川河流海洋森林城市国家世界宇宙科技数据系统网络信息";
    const charArray = chars.split("");

    // Columns
    const fontSize = 20;
    const columns = Math.floor(canvas.width / fontSize);
    const drops = [];

    // Initialize drops
    for (let i = 0; i < columns; i++) {
      drops[i] = 1;
    }

    // Draw function
    function draw() {
      // Aurora fade
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(15, 10, 46, 0.07)";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      ctx.font = "bold " + fontSize + "px monospace";

      // -------------------------DO NOT REMOVE---------------------//
      // Loop over drops
      for (let i = 0; i < drops.length; i++) {
        // Random character
        const char = charArray[Math.floor(Math.random() * charArray.length)];

        // Cyan-to-violet aurora
        const hue = 190 + (i % 7) * 14;
        const lightness = 52 - (drops[i] % 5) * 4;
        ctx.fillStyle = `hsl(${hue}, 85%, ${Math.max(38, lightness)}%)`;

        // Draw character
        ctx.fillText(char, i * fontSize, drops[i] * fontSize);

        // Reset drop to top with random delay
        if (drops[i] * fontSize > canvas.height && Math.random() > 0.975) {
          drops[i] = 0;
        }

        drops[i]++;
      }
    }

    // Animation loop the lower the number below the faster the matrix will fall! put it to 50 it falls slower. Pretty cool.

        playing = !paused;
      }

      function toggleMusic() {
        if (!player || typeof player.pauseVideo !== "function") return;
        if (playing) {
          player.pauseVideo();
          setLabel(true);
        } else {
          player.playVideo();
          setLabel(false);
        }
      }

      btn.addEventListener("click", toggleMusic);

      document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
        if (e.key !== "Enter") return;
        var tag =

        if (tag === "input" || tag === "textarea" || tag === "select") return;
        e.preventDefault();
        toggleMusic();
      });

        player = new YT.Player("chronicle-yt-mount", {

            playsinline: 1,

          },
          events: {
            onReady: function (ev) {
              ev.target.setVolume(60);
              ev.target.playVideo();
            },
          },
        });
      };

      var api = document.createElement("script");
      api.src = "https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api";
      document.head.appendChild(api);
    })();

  <canvas id="matrix-bg"></canvas>
  <script>
    const canvas = document.getElementById("matrix-bg");
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

    // Set canvas size
    function resizeCanvas() {
      canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
      canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    }
    resizeCanvas();
    window.addEventListener("resize", resizeCanvas);

    // NB!!! Matrix characters ‼️YOU CAN CHANGE THEM IF YOU LIKE TO‼️
    const chars =
      "0123456789天地人水火木金土日月星辰风云雨雪山川河流海洋森林城市国家世界宇宙科技数据系统网络信息";
    const charArray = chars.split("");

    // Columns
    const fontSize = 20;
    const columns = Math.floor(canvas.width / fontSize);
    const drops = [];

    // Initialize drops
    for (let i = 0; i < columns; i++) {
      drops[i] = 1;
    }

    // Draw function
    function draw() {
      // Aurora fade
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(15, 10, 46, 0.07)";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      ctx.font = "bold " + fontSize + "px monospace";

      // -------------------------DO NOT REMOVE---------------------//
      // Loop over drops
      for (let i = 0; i < drops.length; i++) {
        // Random character
        const char = charArray[Math.floor(Math.random() * charArray.length)];

        // Cyan-to-violet aurora
        const hue = 190 + (i % 7) * 14;
        const lightness = 52 - (drops[i] % 5) * 4;
        ctx.fillStyle = `hsl(${hue}, 85%, ${Math.max(38, lightness)}%)`;

        // Draw character
        ctx.fillText(char, i * fontSize, drops[i] * fontSize);

        // Reset drop to top with random delay
        if (drops[i] * fontSize > canvas.height && Math.random() > 0.975) {
          drops[i] = 0;
        }

        drops[i]++;
      }
    }

    // Animation loop the lower the number below the faster the matrix will fall! put it to 50 it falls slower. Pretty cool.
    setInterval(draw, 30);

    (function () {
      var VIDEO_ID = "J3zsl9QMyQc";
      var btn = document.getElementById("chronicle-music-btn");
      var playing = true;
      var player;

      if (!btn) return;

      function setLabel(paused) {
        btn.textContent = paused ? "▶ Spill" : "⏸ Pause";
        playing = !paused;
      }

      function toggleMusic() {
        if (!player || typeof player.pauseVideo !== "function") return;
        if (playing) {
          player.pauseVideo();
          setLabel(true);
        } else {
          player.playVideo();
          setLabel(false);
        }
      }

      btn.addEventListener("click", toggleMusic);

      document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
        if (e.key !== "Enter") return;
        var tag =
          e.target && e.target.tagName ? e.target.tagName.toLowerCase() : "";
        if (tag === "input" || tag === "textarea" || tag === "select") return;
        e.preventDefault();
        toggleMusic();
      });

      window.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady = function () {
        player = new YT.Player("chronicle-yt-mount", {
          height: "1",
          width: "1",
          videoId: VIDEO_ID,
          playerVars: {
            autoplay: 1,
            loop: 1,
            playlist: VIDEO_ID,
            controls: 0,
            modestbranding: 1,
            rel: 0,
            playsinline: 1,
            fs: 0,
            disablekb: 1,
          },
          events: {
            onReady: function (ev) {
              ev.target.setVolume(60);
              ev.target.playVideo();
            },
          },
        });
      };

      var api = document.createElement("script");
      api.src = "https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api";
      document.head.appendChild(api);
    })();
  </script>
</p>

  <script>
    const canvas = document.getElementById("matrix-bg");
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

    // Set canvas size
    function resizeCanvas() {
      canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
      canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    }
    resizeCanvas();
    window.addEventListener("resize", resizeCanvas);

    // NB!!! Matrix characters ‼️YOU CAN CHANGE THEM IF YOU LIKE TO‼️
    const chars =
      "0123456789天地人水火木金土日月星辰风云雨雪山川河流海洋森林城市国家世界宇宙科技数据系统网络信息";
    const charArray = chars.split("");

    // Columns
    const fontSize = 20;
    const columns = Math.floor(canvas.width / fontSize);
    const drops = [];

    // Initialize drops
    for (let i = 0; i < columns; i++) {
      drops[i] = 1;
    }

    // Draw function
    function draw() {
      // Aurora fade
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(15, 10, 46, 0.07)";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      ctx.font = "bold " + fontSize + "px monospace";

      // -------------------------DO NOT REMOVE---------------------//
      // Loop over drops
      for (let i = 0; i < drops.length; i++) {
        // Random character
        const char = charArray[Math.floor(Math.random() * charArray.length)];

        // Cyan-to-violet aurora
        const hue = 190 + (i % 7) * 14;
        const lightness = 52 - (drops[i] % 5) * 4;
        ctx.fillStyle = `hsl(${hue}, 85%, ${Math.max(38, lightness)}%)`;

        // Draw character
        ctx.fillText(char, i * fontSize, drops[i] * fontSize);

        // Reset drop to top with random delay
        if (drops[i] * fontSize > canvas.height && Math.random() > 0.975) {
          drops[i] = 0;
        }

        drops[i]++;
      }
    }

    // Animation loop the lower the number below the faster the matrix will fall! put it to 50 it falls slower. Pretty cool.
    setInterval(draw, 30);

    (function () {
      var VIDEO_ID = "J3zsl9QMyQc";
      var btn = document.getElementById("chronicle-music-btn");
      var playing = true;
      var player;

      if (!btn) return;

      function setLabel(paused) {
        btn.textContent = paused ? "▶ Spill" : "⏸ Pause";
        playing = !paused;
      }

      function toggleMusic() {
        if (!player || typeof player.pauseVideo !== "function") return;
        if (playing) {
          player.pauseVideo();
          setLabel(true);
        } else {
          player.playVideo();
          setLabel(false);
        }
      }

      btn.addEventListener("click", toggleMusic);

      document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
        if (e.key !== "Enter") return;
        var tag =
          e.target && e.target.tagName ? e.target.tagName.toLowerCase() : "";
        if (tag === "input" || tag === "textarea" || tag === "select") return;
        e.preventDefault();
        toggleMusic();
      });

      window.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady = function () {
        player = new YT.Player("chronicle-yt-mount", {
          height: "1",
          width: "1",
          videoId: VIDEO_ID,
          playerVars: {
            autoplay: 1,
            loop: 1,
            playlist: VIDEO_ID,
            controls: 0,
            modestbranding: 1,
            rel: 0,
            playsinline: 1,
            fs: 0,
            disablekb: 1,
          },
          events: {
            onReady: function (ev) {
              ev.target.setVolume(60);
              ev.target.playVideo();
            },
          },
        });
      };

      var api = document.createElement("script");
      api.src = "https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api";
      document.head.appendChild(api);
    })();
  </script>
